newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 6-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR FRI.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK C.BANK SETS 6-DAY REV REPO TENDER FOR FRI.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Friday it had set a tender for a six-day securities reverse repurchase for 10 a.m. (0900 GMT), offering to drain an unspecified volume of market liquidity.
The NBS said in a statement that the American-style tender would have no fixed minimum rate.
According to official NBS figures, the banking sector is short of liquidity, with banks' minimum reserve demands fulfilled at 98.02 percent as of Thursday, after 96.53 percent the previous day.
The NBS's reverse repo tender of a similar, seven-day maturity, on Thursday failed to attract any bids.
